hero.title: How to Apply to
hero.description: A complete guide to navigating the application process, from gathering documents to receiving your acceptance letter. Start your journey to studying in Germany.

routes.title: Two Ways to Apply
routes.description: You cannot apply directly to a Studienkolleg. Applications must go through the university.

uniAssist.title: Via uni-assist
uniAssist.description: Many German universities use uni-assist to process international applications. You submit documents once, and they verify and forward them.

direct.title: Direct to University
direct.description: Some universities accept direct applications. Check the specific university's international office for their process.

steps.title: Application Steps
steps.description: Follow these steps to successfully apply to a Studienkolleg.

items.title: Research & Choose
items.description: Research Studienkollegs and choose your target universities. Decide on your course track (G, M, T, W, or S).
items.tip: Apply to multiple Studienkollegs to increase your chances.

items.title: Gather Documents
items.description: Collect all required documents. Get translations certified and notarized where needed.
items.tip: Start this process at least 2 months before deadline.

items.title: Submit Application
items.description: Apply through uni-assist or directly to the university. Pay application fees and upload all documents.

items.title: Entrance Exam
items.description: If your application is approved, you'll be invited to take the entrance exam (Aufnahmeprüfung).
items.tip: Practice German and math daily before the exam.

items.title: Visa & Arrival
items.description: After acceptance, open a blocked account, get health insurance, and apply for your student visa.

documents.title: Required Documents
documents.description: Prepare these documents before starting your application.
items: Passport copy (valid for at least 6 months)
documents.warning: Important: Each Studienkolleg may have additional requirements. Always check the specific institution's website for their complete checklist.

deadlines.title: Application Deadlines
deadlines.description: Mark these dates in your calendar. Studienkolleg deadlines are often earlier than university deadlines.
deadlines.disclaimer: Some universities have earlier deadlines. Always verify with your target institution.

exam.title: Entrance Exam
exam.subtitle: Aufnahmeprüfung
exam.description: Public Studienkollegs require you to pass an entrance exam. This tests your German language skills and, for technical tracks (M, T, W), basic mathematics.

german.title: German Test
german.description: Reading, writing, grammar, and listening comprehension.

math.title: Math Test
math.description: For M, T, W courses. Covers algebra, geometry, functions.

when.title: When
when.description: September (for winter) and February (for summer semester).

visa.title: After Acceptance
visa.description: Once accepted, complete these steps before traveling to Germany.

blockedAccount.title: Blocked Account
blockedAccount.description: Open a blocked account (Sperrkonto) with approximately €11,904/year to prove financial stability.

healthInsurance.title: Health Insurance
healthInsurance.description: Get German health insurance (public or private). Mandatory for enrollment and visa.

studentVisa.title: Student Visa
studentVisa.description: Apply for a student visa at the German Embassy in your country. Book your appointment early as wait times can be several weeks.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Application?
cta.description: Begin your preparation today. Our structured course helps you master the entrance exam.
